title: Teardown and Reassembly Labor Schedule for Insurance Claim Repairs
content:
When an Insurance Claim Repairs vehicle has been disassembled and the repair does not go ahead, the disassembly is billed at fixed per-class hours: to the insurer when the vehicle is declared a total loss after teardown, and to the customer when a vehicle with completed teardown is withdrawn before work starts.

| Repair class | Total-loss teardown hours (billed to the insurer) | Withdrawal teardown hours (charged to the customer) | Labor rate for withdrawal teardown and reassembly | Reassembly before release on withdrawal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Claim Repair | 0.0 | 0.0 | USD 62.00 per hour | No |
| Standard Claim Repair | 2.0 | 1.5 | USD 62.00 per hour | Yes |
| Major Claim Repair | 4.0 | 3.0 | USD 62.00 per hour | Yes |
| Structural Claim Repair | 6.0 | 4.0 | USD 68.00 per hour | Yes |
| Certified Structural Claim Repair | 8.0 | 6.0 | USD 74.00 per hour | Yes |
| Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair | 10.0 | 8.0 | USD 82.00 per hour | Yes |

**Hours** are stated to one decimal place. **Reassembly** states whether a disassembled vehicle is put back together before release on withdrawal, at the same hours as the teardown.

### Schedule arithmetic, hypothetical

- Standard Claim Repair, 1.5 withdrawal teardown hours at USD 62.00: USD 93.00 for the teardown; the same hours again for reassembly come to a further USD 93.00.
- Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair, 8.0 withdrawal teardown hours at USD 82.00: USD 656.00 for the teardown.
- Express Claim Repair carries 0.0 hours in both teardown columns, so no hours are scheduled in that class.
